name: A-Skip
cue_short: Skip with knee drive and quick ground contact.

name: Ab Wheel Rollout
cue_short: From knees, roll out only as far as ribs stay down.

name: Assisted Pull-Up
cue_short: Full hang to chin over bar with help from band or machine.

name: Back Squat
cue_short: Brace, sit down and back; knees track, finish tall.

name: Band Chest Press
cue_short: Band behind back or anchored; press without losing rib position.

name: Band Face Pull to External Rotation
cue_short: Pull to face, then rotate hands back; pause.

name: Band Lat Pulldown
cue_short: Pull band down to collarbone; elbows toward ribs.

name: Band Overhead Press
cue_short: Stand on band, press overhead without rib flare.

name: Band Row
cue_short: Pull elbows back; stop before shrugging up.

name: Band Goblet-Style Squat
cue_short: Stand on band, hold handles at shoulders, squat.

name: Barbell Bench Press
cue_short: Pull bar to chest, drive feet, press in a slight arc.

name: Barbell Overhead Press
cue_short: Bar from shoulders to lockout; move head through at the top.

name: Barbell Romanian Deadlift
cue_short: Bar stays close; hinge until hamstrings load, then stand.

name: Barbell Bent-Over Row
cue_short: Hinge, brace, row bar to lower ribs without yanking.

name: Bear Crawl
cue_short: Knees hover; opposite hand/foot step; hips low and level.

name: Bird Dog
cue_short: Opposite arm and leg reach; hips level; pause.

name: Box Jump
cue_short: Load, jump onto box, soft land, step down.

name: Bodyweight Box Squat
cue_short: Sit back to box, brief touch, drive up; knees track over toes.

name: Cable Anti-Rotation Hold
cue_short: Arms locked out in front; hold without twisting.

name: Cable Chop
cue_short: High to low chop across the body; hips and shoulders turn together.

name: Cable Lift
cue_short: Low to high lift across the body with braced rotation.

name: Cable Pull-Through
cue_short: Face away from stack; hinge and snap hips to standing.

name: Seated Cable Row
cue_short: Tall torso; pull to ribs, control the return.

name: Cat-Cow
cue_short: On all fours; alternate rounding and arching slowly.

name: Chest-Supported Dumbbell Row
cue_short: Chest on incline bench; row without lower-back stress.

name: Chin-Up
cue_short: Underhand grip; pull chin over bar with control.

name: Close-Grip Bench Press
cue_short: Hands just inside shoulders; elbows track close.

name: Conventional Deadlift
cue_short: Bar over mid-foot; brace, push floor, finish with hips through.

name: McGill Curl-Up
cue_short: One knee bent; hands under low back; lift head/shoulders slightly.

name: Dumbbell Bench Press
cue_short: Feet planted, soft arch, dumbbells travel over mid-chest.

name: Dumbbell Floor Press
cue_short: Upper arms touch floor; press without flaring hard.

name: Dumbbell Romanian Deadlift
cue_short: Hips back, soft knees, dumbbells skim thighs; flat back.

name: Dumbbell Rear-Foot-Elevated Split Squat
cue_short: Same RFESS pattern with dumbbells at sides.

name: Single-Arm Dumbbell Row
cue_short: Hinge support hand on bench; row elbow to hip.

name: Standing Dumbbell Shoulder Press
cue_short: Brace hard; press up without leaning into lumbar extension.

name: Dumbbell Swing
cue_short: Hold one DB by the bell end; same hip-snap pattern as KB swing.

name: Dead Bug
cue_short: Low back gently pressed down; opposite arm/leg reach without flaring ribs.

name: Decline Push-Up
cue_short: Feet elevated; keep hips level and press evenly.

name: Face Pull
cue_short: Pull to face height; externally rotate at the end.

name: Farmer Carry
cue_short: Heavy loads at sides; tall posture, walk smooth.

name: Feet-Elevated Push-Up (High)
cue_short: Higher feet elevation; own the plank under more load.

name: Front Plank
cue_short: Elbows under shoulders; long body; squeeze glutes.

name: Front-Rack Carry
cue_short: Bells racked at shoulders; ribs down, walk.

name: Front Squat
cue_short: Bar on front delts; elbows high; sit between hips.

name: Glute Bridge
cue_short: Drive through heels; squeeze glutes at the top, ribs down.

name: Goblet Squat
cue_short: Hold weight at chest; elbows inside knees at the bottom.

name: Half-Kneeling Pallof Press
cue_short: Half-kneeling; press out and own the hip/rib stack.

name: 90/90 Hip Switches
cue_short: Both knees bent 90; switch sides with tall torso.

name: Dowel Hip Hinge Drill
cue_short: Rod along spine stays in contact at head, mid-back, and sacrum.

name: Incline Push-Up
cue_short: Hands on bench or box; rigid torso, chest to edge.

name: Inverted Row
cue_short: Body straight; pull chest to bar, squeeze shoulder blades.

name: Kettlebell Deadlift
cue_short: Hinge to kettlebell between feet; stand tall without yanking.

name: Kettlebell Swing
cue_short: Hike pass, snap hips; float bell to chest height, not a squat.

name: Landmine Press
cue_short: Press on an arc; ribs down, no leaning back.

name: Lat Pulldown
cue_short: Pull bar to upper chest; no leaning back hard.

name: Lateral Lunge
cue_short: Step sideways, sit into that hip, other leg straight.

name: Leg Press
cue_short: Feet mid-platform; control depth without rounding low back.

name: Machine Chest Press
cue_short: Seat so handles meet mid-chest; controlled tempo.

name: Machine Row
cue_short: Chest pad set so you can reach without rounding.

name: Machine Shoulder Press
cue_short: Seat so handles start near shoulder height; press smoothly.

name: March in Place
cue_short: Tall posture; drive knees up with opposite arm swing.

name: Med-Ball Rotational Throw
cue_short: Load the back hip, throw into wall hard, catch or reset.

name: Open Book
cue_short: Side-lying; open top arm and follow with eyes/chest.

name: Overhead Carry
cue_short: Lock out overhead; walk without leaning or flaring ribs.

name: Pallof Press
cue_short: Press handle straight out; resist being twisted.

name: Pike Push-Up
cue_short: Hips high, head toward floor between hands, press up.

name: Plate Hug Carry
cue_short: Hug a plate to the chest; walk tall.

name: Pull-Up
cue_short: Dead hang, pull chin over bar, no kip unless programmed.

name: Push-Up
cue_short: Plank body, chest to floor, no sagging hips.

name: Rear-Foot-Elevated Split Squat
cue_short: Back foot on bench; most load on front leg.

name: Reverse Lunge
cue_short: Step back, drop knee, return; often knee-friendlier than forward lunge.

name: Seated Dumbbell Shoulder Press
cue_short: Back supported; press in a controlled vertical path.

name: Side Plank
cue_short: Elbow under shoulder; hips up; body in one line.

name: Single-Leg Romanian Deadlift
cue_short: Hinge on one leg; hips square, soft knee, reach back with free leg.

name: Sit-to-Stand
cue_short: Sit to box with control, stand without using hands if possible.

name: Sled Drag (Backward or Forward)
cue_short: Strap on; walk or backward drag with steady posture.

name: Sled Push
cue_short: Forward lean into handles; drive legs, short powerful steps.

name: Bodyweight Split Squat
cue_short: Long split stance; lower back knee toward floor, front shin mostly vertical.

name: Step-Up
cue_short: Drive through whole front foot; stand tall without pushing off back toe hard.

name: Suitcase Carry
cue_short: Load in one hand; do not lean; walk tall.

name: Suitcase Hold
cue_short: Hold load at side while standing tall; do not lean.

name: Trap-Bar Deadlift
cue_short: Stand inside trap bar; brace, push floor away, lock hips.

name: Walking Lunge
cue_short: Step forward, descend, then next step; torso tall.

name: Wall Push-Up
cue_short: Hands on wall, body straight, press away without shrugging.

name: Weighted Pull-Up
cue_short: Same as pull-up with added load at waist or feet.

name: World's Greatest Stretch
cue_short: Lunge, hand down, rotate open toward front leg.
